user_question: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospitals to census tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform hospital point geometries into the census tract layer's projected CRS so the binary spatial join can be performed with compatible CRSs.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the hospital vector layer from its observed CRS to EPSG:26918. Preserve all hospital attributes and point geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Assign hospitals to containing census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Perform a point-in-polygon spatial join between the reprojected hospitals and Centre County census tracts, retaining hospital attributes and adding the containing tract identifier.
workflow_steps.instructions: Join each hospital point to the census tract polygon that contains it. Preserve the hospital records and attributes, and include the census tract identifier field from the polygon layer in the output. Do not assume or rename schema fields; runtime QC must ground the tract identifier from the observed census tract schema.

requirements.scope: The hospital point layer and census tract polygon layer used by task assign_hospitals_to_census_tracts must have compatible CRSs for the spatial join.
The census tract input used by task assign_hospitals_to_census_tracts must contain a field that identifies each tract and that field must be retained in the joined output.
